name: personal-planner
description: Private access to your independently hosted Personal Planner tasks, with separate revocable read or write permissions.

interface.longDescription: Read, create and update your Personal Planner tasks from conversations. Connect using a separate key generated in Planner Settings. Your owner key is never used by this plugin. Permission can be revoked in Planner without changing your owner login or tasks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my tasks and help me choose what to do next.
